content.title: SKF 6200 Open Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 10mm Bore x 30mm OD x 9mm Width
content.short_description: SKF 6200 open-type deep groove ball bearing with 10 mm bore, 30 mm OD, and 9 mm width. Dynamic load rating 5.1 kN, static load rating 2.36 kN, limiting speed 32,000 rpm.
content.long_description:
The SKF 6200 is a single-row deep groove ball bearing in an open configuration, with no integrated seals or shields on either side. It is sized for a 10 mm bore, 30 mm outer diameter, and 9 mm width, matching the standard 6200-series envelope for compact shaft-mounted applications.

Load capacity is rated at 5.1 kN dynamic (C) and 2.36 kN static (C0), suitable for radial and light axial loading within these limits. The bearing carries a limiting speed rating of 32,000 rpm, applicable under standard reference conditions per SKF ratings methodology.

As an open bearing, the 6200 is intended for applications where the housing or adjacent components provide contamination protection, or where relubrication access is required. Confirm mounting clearances and lubrication compatibility with the 10 x 30 x 9 mm envelope before installation.
